title: Live BTCUSDT WFA - RSI Momentum on Real Binance Data
objective: Fetch live BTCUSDT 1h data from Binance API and run walk-forward analysis using RSI momentum strategy to produce real evidence.
hypothesis: Running RSI momentum strategy on real Binance BTCUSDT data via WFA will produce measurable backtest results with verifiable metrics, improving evidence score above the baseline of 25 from demo-data-only experiments.
dataset_requirements: Live BTCUSDT OHLCV data from Binance public API
At least 500 candles for meaningful WFA (30-day minimum at 1h interval)
implementation_steps: 1. Execute Binance fetcher to get BTCUSDT 1h data (500+ candles)
3. Load live data into WFA engine
4. Configure RSI momentum strategy with standard parameters (period=14, overbought=70, oversold=30)
5. Run WFA backtest with train window >= 200 candles, test window >= 50 candles
6. Generate performance metrics: total return, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, win rate
8. Evaluate evidence quality and produce verdict
commands: cd /mnt/c/Users/הלל/Desktop/algo/projects/trading-research-factory && python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; from workspace.data.fetchers.binance_fetcher import fetch_klines; klines = fetch_klines('BTCUSDT', '1h', 500); print(json.dumps({'rows': len(klines), 'latest': klines[-1][0] if klines else None}))"

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: WFA backtest completes successfully on live data with at least 10 trades

fallback_if_blocked: Binance API unreachable - use demo_ohlcv.csv as fallback with clear notation
WFA engine error - document error and produce partial evidence
Strategy error - fallback to SMA crossover strategy
notes: This is the first experiment using real live market data instead of synthetic/demo data
Binance public API requires no authentication for public klines endpoint
If successful, establishes pattern for fetching other crypto pairs (ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT)
Evidence score target of 40 exceeds previous baseline of 25 from demo-only experiments
